global.title: Ukraine strike on Novorossiysk disrupts Russian grain terminals
global.summary: A Ukrainian attack reportedly hit warships at Russia’s Novorossiysk naval base and forced two major grain terminals to halt operations, raising concerns about global wheat supplies.
global.whyItMatters: This connects war to food insecurity, offering a concrete way to pray for civilians, peace, and vulnerable nations affected by rising costs.

global.title: Israeli army adds forces after settlers trap Palestinian families in West Bank village
global.summary: Two Palestinian families in Qusra were reportedly trapped in their homes for days amid repeated settler attacks, prompting the Israeli army to assign an extra battalion to the area.
global.whyItMatters: Pastors may want to pray and speak carefully about protection for civilians, justice, and peace in a conflict that keeps harming ordinary families.

global.title: Trump orders major reduction in U.S.-South Korea military drills
global.summary: President Trump said joint drills with South Korea would be substantially reduced despite warnings that North Korea is gaining battlefield lessons through its ties with Russia and the war in Ukraine.
global.whyItMatters: Shifts in deterrence on the Korean peninsula can quickly affect global stability and remind congregations to pray for wise leadership in volatile regions.

canadian.title: Canada fears new U.S. tariffs may be unavoidable
canadian.summary: CBC reports Canadian negotiators increasingly fear new U.S. tariffs may be hard to avoid as talks continue under deadline pressure.
canadian.whyItMatters: Trade strain can affect jobs, prices, and anxiety in local households, making this relevant for pastoral care and community awareness.

canadian.title: B.C. wildfire may signal a 'new normal' for fire speed and evacuations
canadian.summary: After the Bald Range wildfire forced about 20,000 people to flee and killed an 80-year-old woman, Premier David Eby said the province must learn from how quickly the fire moved.
canadian.whyItMatters: This shapes how churches think about emergency readiness, care for evacuees, and ministry in a province facing repeated climate-driven disruption.

canadian.title: WestJet harassment class action settlement approved
canadian.summary: A $4.5 million settlement has been approved in a workplace harassment class action involving WestJet, according to Global News programming highlights.
canadian.whyItMatters: It is a reminder that healthy culture, accountability, and protection from abuse matter in every institution, including churches and ministries.

local.title: WorkSafeBC fines Fraser Valley construction companies over preventable hazards
local.summary: WorkSafeBC announced penalties for several Fraser Valley construction employers, including cases involving ignored stop-work orders, missing fall protection, and a struck gas line.
local.whyItMatters: This is a practical local reminder that leadership includes safeguarding workers and valuing people over speed or profit.

local.title: Support grows for Chilliwack boy facing kidney cancer treatment
local.summary: A Chilliwack family is receiving community support after their 6-year-old son Kane was diagnosed with Wilms tumour and underwent major surgery, with radiation and chemotherapy still ahead.
local.whyItMatters: This is a clear opportunity for prayer, compassion, and tangible care for a local family carrying a heavy burden.

local.title: Chilliwack RCMP renew appeal in case of missing Vancouver man
local.summary: Police released more details and again asked for public help in locating Taetm Moon, a 28-year-old Indigenous man last seen in Chilliwack in late May.
local.whyItMatters: Missing-person cases weigh heavily on families and communities, and pastors may wish to pray, share awareness, and support those living with uncertainty.

persecutedChurch.title: At least 30 Christians killed in Nigerian village attack
persecutedChurch.summary: Reports say Islamic extremists killed at least 30 Christians, including children, in Naridon village in Kaduna state, with local leaders calling for urgent security action.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This is a direct call to prayer for grieving believers and a reminder to keep the suffering church visible in worship and intercession.

persecutedChurch.title: Armenian church leader faces trial amid concerns over religious autonomy
persecutedChurch.summary: International Christian Concern says the trial of Karekin II is being widely viewed as politically motivated and as a test of the limits between state power and church independence.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: It highlights how pressure on church leadership can come through courts and politics, not only through overt violence.

leadership.title: Relationships drive longevity and workplace culture
leadership.summary: A Forbes piece argues that sustainable leadership is built less on perks and hustle and more on long-term habits, healthy boundaries, and genuine human connection.
leadership.whyItMatters: For a pastor, this reinforces that resilient ministry culture grows through trust, rhythms, and relationships rather than constant urgency.

goodNews.title: Surrey food rescue event sets record for produce donation
goodNews.summary: A weekend event in Surrey helped collect 543,501 pounds of fresh fruits and vegetables in 24 hours, setting a Guinness World Record and redirecting good food to people who need it.
goodNews.whyItMatters: It is a hopeful local-to-Canada story of generosity, stewardship, and practical love for neighbours.
